arguments.sql:
WITH oldest AS (
    SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
    FROM drivers AS d
    JOIN results AS w ON w.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = w.raceId
    WHERE w.position = 1 AND r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 AND d.dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY d.dob, d.forename || ' ' || d.surname
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT o.forename, o.surname, o.dob, r.name, r.date, x.grid, x.laps, x.positionText, s.status
FROM oldest AS o
JOIN results AS x ON x.driverId = o.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = x.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = x.statusId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
ORDER BY r.date

arguments.sql:
WITH career_results AS (
    SELECT x.driverId, x.raceId, x.position, r.name, r.date
    FROM results AS x
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = x.raceId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT d.driverId,
           d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
           d.nationality,
           w.name AS first_win_race,
           w.date AS first_win_date
    FROM career_results AS w
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = w.driverId
    WHERE w.position = 1 AND d.dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY d.dob, full_name, d.driverId, w.date, w.name
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT f.full_name, f.nationality, f.first_win_race, f.first_win_date,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.raceId)
        FROM career_results AS c
        WHERE c.driverId = f.driverId) AS career_starts
FROM first_win AS f
LIMIT 1
